When asked, “Did you prefer Paramount as a buyer to Netflix?”

Adam Aron replied, “I have a lot of respect for all three of the companies that we’re talking about. Warner makes great movies, David Ellison is a movie maker  and Netflix has the potential to embrace theaters much more than it has in the past. So you know, we’ll find out together what happens.”

When asked, “How has your relationship with Netflix improved?”

Adam Aron responded, “Netflix has said publicly, and AMC has said publicly, we expect to do more together in 2026 and beyond. AMC has announced that we will play Greta Gerwig’s upcoming “Narnia” in cooperation with Imax. But we don’t want to wait until then to do more with Netflix. We would love to do more with Netflix right now.”
